outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of breast anatomy plus a classification table with frequency percentages; it is not a plot requiring individual data point overlay.
Panel B is a conceptual schematic illustrating circadian phenotypes and their relationship to drug sensitivity/tumor growth; no data are plotted.
Panel C is a schematic illustrating the experimental method (luciferase recording setup), not a data plot.
Panel D shows idealized example traces (oscillating/damped/decaying) used to illustrate the analysis workflow rather than a real data plot; these illustrative curves are part of a schematic.
Panel E is a correlation heatmap; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel F contains an illustrative example growth curve (Model 1/2/3) used to depict the analysis concept within a schematic workflow, not an actual data plot of results.
Panel G shows an illustrative dose-response curve example used to depict the analysis concept within a schematic workflow, not an actual data plot of results.
Panel H is a schematic illustrating the genomic analysis workflow with example icon-like heatmap/mutation matrix graphics, not a data plot of actual results.
Panel I shows scatter plots (PCA cluster plot and 3D parameter scatter plot); scatter plots inherently display individual data points and are exempt from this check.
